decisions.reason: The accepted removal of duplicate and unused iOS images is already fully represented by the candidate's message-38 MODIFY; no additional update or removal is required.
Android App Bundle packaging is already fully established by the candidate's message-38 INTRODUCE, so another same-message MODIFY would duplicate the requirement state.
The source change concerns Android App Bundle packaging, code shrinking, and image removal; it does not change the existing iOS Thinning requirement.
Android size and packaging changes do not alter localization coverage or language-file alignment, which is independently represented in the candidate history.
App Bundle, code shrinking, and image-removal requirements do not change the Android RTL layout requirement.
The Android download-size change does not alter iOS localization coverage or translation-system reconstruction, which is already independently represented.
At message 38, the Youku video's lifecycle remained an unresolved client question; the Android size changes do not resolve whether the video should remain or be removed.
Android size optimization does not change the independently accepted requirement to renew iOS signing certificates.
App packaging and size optimization do not change Android API-level, deprecated-API, or dependency-modernization requirements.
Removing duplicate images and enabling packaging optimizations do not alter the separate policy requiring removal of the unused READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
The Android download-size changes do not alter the iOS version target, deprecated-API modernization, or UIWebView replacement requirements.
Android packaging and size optimization have no necessary effect on the independent iOS Privacy Manifest requirement.
